name: keep-coding
description: Evidence-gated durable memory for long-running coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Keep large agent projects coherent and verified.
interface.longDescription: Turns large project prompts into adaptive durable contracts, dependency-aware phases, semantic impact analysis, evidence-backed checkpoints, approvals, budgets, and resumable cross-runtime context.
defaultPrompt: Build this project end to end and keep every phase verified.
Continue the active project from its latest checkpoint.
